description: How much attic ventilation you need by the 1/150 and 1/300 rules (Florida Building Code, Residential R806.2), split into intake and exhaust, and how many vents that is for your vent products. Formula: Total net free area (sq in) = attic floor area (sq ft) × 144 ÷ 150 (or ÷ 300 under the balanced exception). Exhaust NFA = total × high share; intake NFA = the rest. Vents = ⌈NFA ÷ the net free area of one vent (or one foot of continuous vent)⌉.

attic_floor_sqft.description: Attic floor area (vented space) (sq ft); default 1500

exhaust_nfa_per_unit.description: Exhaust vent net free area per unit or per ft of ridge vent (from the label) (sq in); default 18

intake_nfa_per_unit.description: Intake vent net free area per unit or per ft of soffit vent (from the label) (sq in); default 9

ratio.description: Ventilation rule; default 150; one of 150 = 1/150 (standard), 300 = 1/300 (balanced exception: 40–50% high)

upper_pct.description: Share of vent area that is high (exhaust) (%); default 50

name: calc_attic_ventilation
title: Attic Ventilation Calculator (Net Free Area, Ridge & Soffit Vents)
